commitResults.messageTitle: Update name to Yappy and add simple intro

commitResults.messageBody:
Read user input line by line with a Scanner and echo each line back
between dividers, so the bot now responds to input instead of exiting
immediately.

The loop is guarded by hasNextLine() as well as the bye command, so
piping input from a file that lacks a trailing bye terminates cleanly
rather than throwing NoSuchElementException.

commitResults.messageTitle: Store user input and list it on demand
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the echo behaviour with a simple store: each line the user
types is kept in a fixed-size String[100], and the list command prints
the stored items back, numbered from 1.

A fixed array is enough because the requirements cap the list at 100
items; taskCount is needed alongside it because an array's length is
its capacity, not the number of filled slots. Adding beyond the cap
reports a message instead of throwing ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add mark command to set a task as done
commitResults.messageBody:
Track completion status in a boolean array that runs parallel to the
task descriptions, so no new class is needed at this step, and show the
status in the list output as [X] or [ ].

The list output also gains the "Here are the tasks in your list:"
header to match the expected format.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add unmark command to reverse a task back to not done
commitResults.messageBody:
Mirrors the mark command by clearing the flag in the isDone array.

The unmark branch is checked separately from mark rather than sharing
one branch, because startsWith("mark ") does not match "unmark 2",
so the two commands cannot be confused for each other.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract a Task class to hold description and status together
commitResults.messageBody:
Replace the parallel String[]/boolean[] arrays with a single Task[].
Each Task owns its description and done-status, so the two can no
longer drift out of step, and the status formatting moves into
Task.toString() instead of a helper in Yappy.

Behaviour is unchanged: this step is a refactor in preparation for
subtypes of Task (todo, deadline, event) in later increments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add typed tasks and UI tests
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce Todo, Deadline, and Event subclasses so Yappy can track typed tasks using inheritance while preserving shared done-status behavior. Add a project-specific test-ui skill, UI test plan, runner, and recorded session to verify the console workflow after updates.

Introduce YappyException and route invalid console inputs through user-friendly exception messages. Validate empty commands, malformed task commands, and invalid mark/unmark indexes while expanding the UI test plan to cover negative cases without changing task state.

Store tasks in an ArrayList so the list can grow dynamically and remove items cleanly. Add delete command handling with existing YappyException validation and expand UI tests for deletion and invalid delete inputs.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use enums for commands and task types
commitResults.messageBody: Add Command and TaskType enums for fixed command words and task display icons. Route command parsing through Command and let Task own TaskType-based display so subclasses no longer hardcode type icons.
